hero.title: DIGITISE YOUR BUSINESS

problem.title:
TOO MANY TOOLS,
TOO LITTLE REAL SUPPORT.
problem.description: SMEs end up with scattered tools and no trusted technical partner. When something breaks — and it always does — nobody knows who to call or how to fix it fast.

items.text: Hours lost switching between disconnected platforms
No support when the system goes down or an incident occurs
No unified view or control of the digital business

services.title:
EVERYTHING YOU NEED,
WITH ONE TEAM.
services.subtitle: From design to ongoing maintenance, without changing providers.

items.title: Websites & landings
items.description: Professional landing pages optimised for conversion. Premium design, technical SEO and measured performance.

items.title: Automations
items.description: Custom workflows for WhatsApp, email, CRM and any repetitive process in your business.

items.title: Maintenance & SLA

items.title: Changes & evolution

howItWorks.title:
WE WORK IN PHASES,
AT YOUR PACE.

steps.title: We study your needs
steps.description: A discovery session to understand your business, your current processes and your goals. No strings attached.

steps.title: Phase-by-phase quote
steps.description: You receive a detailed, transparent proposal broken into phases. You choose which ones to implement and when.

steps.title: We build and launch
steps.description: Each phase is developed, tested and deployed. You have portal access to track all your services in real time.

steps.title: We stay by your side
steps.description: Maintenance, incident resolution and iterative improvements. The system grows with your business.

service.title:
A TECHNICAL PARTNER,
NOT A VENDOR.
service.subtitle: Every client is different. That's why we don't have fixed rates: we study your needs and propose a phased solution with transparent pricing.

pillars.title: Personalised study
pillars.description: We analyse your business, processes and goals. We design a tailored solution — no generic templates.

pillars.title: Phase-based quote
pillars.description: A clear, detailed proposal. You implement the phases you want, at your own pace and budget, with no forced commitments.

pillars.title: Maintenance, backups & incidents
pillars.description: System monitored 24/7 with regular backups. When an incident happens, we resolve it. If the service goes down, we're the first to know and act.

pillars.title: Changes & growth
pillars.description: Your business evolves and so does the system. We adapt, improve and expand capabilities whenever you need it.

service.note: Free initial consultation, no commitment. We'll explain exactly how we can help you.

portalPreview.title:
YOUR ENTIRE BUSINESS,
ALWAYS VISIBLE.
portalPreview.subtitle: Every client gets access to a private dashboard where they can check the status of all their services, invoices and incidents in real time — without having to ask.

features.title: Real-time status
features.description: Know at a glance whether your website, automations and systems are running.

features.title: Invoices & documents
features.description: Access all invoices and a summary of your contracted services.

features.title: Alerts & incidents
features.description: We notify you when we detect a problem. You can track it directly from the portal.

items.name: Maria Rosselló
items.text: Since working with AMG, I no longer worry about the website or automations. Everything runs smoothly and if there's an issue, they fix it before I even notice.

items.name: Pere Fullana
items.text: The client portal is amazing. I can see the status of my entire business in real time, my invoices and even the active automations. 100% recommended.

items.name: Caterina Cantallops
items.text: We started with a landing page and now the entire office is automated. The support is immediate and always resolves any questions. I wouldn't change teams for anything.
